verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies durability: the graph-based Workflow Runtime lists retry, state management and human-in-the-loop. Artifacts are described as persistent outputs that outlast the conversation, and a managed Agent Runtime exists for deployment. Nothing explicitly shows agents surviving process restarts or deploys. Missing for 10: documented checkpoint/resume of in-flight runs across restarts, persistent session/state backends, durable-execution integrations (e.g. Temporal-style), and independent or hands-on corroboration of durability.
